_meta.source: Minimal extracted/reference export for audit and tooling
_meta.note: Item gameplay/runtime definitions now live in src/data/*. Prefer dungeon.json/objectDatabase + originalAtari for source-truth data. itemTypeNames now omit unproven placeholder entries instead of inventing names.

spells.name: Torch (light)
spells.effect: Creates a magic torch in hand
spells.note: Confirmed in dungeon text: "INVOKE FUL FOR A MAGIC TORCH"

spells.name: Darkness
spells.effect: Extinguishes all light sources nearby

spells.name: Light (Oh Ir Ra)
spells.effect: Creates a powerful sustained light
spells.note: Confirmed: "LIGHT / OH IR RA"

spells.name: Magic Vision
spells.effect: Reveals invisible objects and secret doors
spells.note: Confirmed: "OH EW RA BESTOWS MAGIC VISION"

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.effect: Makes the party invisible to monsters
spells.note: Confirmed: "INVISIBILITY / OH EW SAR"

spells.name: Fireball
spells.effect: Launches a fireball projectile
spells.note: Confirmed: "FIREBALL / FUL IR"

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.effect: Creates a protective fire shield potion
spells.note: Confirmed: "FIRE SHIELD / FUL BRO NETA"

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.effect: Launches a lightning bolt
spells.note: Confirmed: "LIGHTNING BOLT / OH KATH RA"

spells.name: Poison Cloud
spells.effect: Casts a cloud of poison in front of party
spells.note: Confirmed: "OH VEN CAST A CLOUD OF POISON"

spells.name: Poison Bolt
spells.effect: Conjures a poison bolt projectile
spells.note: Confirmed: "DES VEN WILL CONJURE A POISON SPELL"

spells.name: Magic Footprints
spells.effect: Creates glowing footprints to mark your path
spells.note: Confirmed: "YA BRO ROS LEAVES A TRAIL OF MAGIC FOOTPRINTS"

spells.name: Open Door
spells.effect: Opens certain locked doors
spells.note: Confirmed: "SOME DOORS CAN BE OPENED WITH A ZO SPELL"

spells.name: Heal (minor)
spells.effect: Heals light wounds of one champion

spells.name: Heal (major)
spells.effect: Heals moderate wounds of one champion

spells.name: Health Potion
spells.effect: Creates a health potion (cast into empty flask)
spells.note: Confirmed: "CASTING VI / INTO A FLASK CREATES A SERUM THAT HEALS WOUNDS"

spells.name: Antidote Potion
spells.effect: Creates an antidote/anti-poison potion (cast into empty flask)
spells.note: Confirmed: "CASTING VI BRO INTO A FLASK CREATES A SERUM FOR CURING POISON"

spells.name: Stamina Potion
spells.effect: Creates a stamina potion (cast into empty flask)
spells.note: Confirmed: "YA WILL CREATE A STAMINA POTION"

spells.name: Shield Potion
spells.effect: Creates a magic shield potion (cast into empty flask)
spells.note: Confirmed: "SHIELD POTION / YA BRO" and "YA BRO CREATES A MAGICAL SHIELD POTION"

spells.name: Mana Potion
spells.effect: Creates a mana potion (cast into empty flask)
spells.note: Confirmed: "ZO BRO RA CREATES A PURE MANA POTION"

spells.name: Fighter Boost Potion
spells.effect: Creates a potion boosting Fighter skills
spells.note: Confirmed in dungeon text

spells.name: Priest Boost Potion
spells.effect: Creates a potion boosting Priest skills
spells.note: Confirmed in dungeon text

spells.name: Ninja Boost Potion
spells.effect: Creates a potion boosting Ninja skills
spells.note: Confirmed in dungeon text

spells.name: Wizard Boost Potion
spells.effect: Creates a potion boosting Wizard skills
spells.note: Confirmed in dungeon text

spells.name: Magic Shield
spells.effect: Surrounds party with a defensive magical shield
spells.note: Confirmed: "MAGIC SHIELD / YA IR"

spells.name: Zokathra
spells.effect: Creates a plasma bolt that can melt certain magical barriers (needed for Gem)
spells.note: Confirmed: "ZOKATHRA MIGHT CREATE A PLASMA THAT COULD BURN THROUGH THE AMALGAM"

spellCastingRules.castingOrder: Power rune first, then 1-3 additional runes in any order
spellCastingRules.skillEffect: Higher skill level increases damage/duration/effect and reduces mana waste

classBonus.Fighter: Bonus to YA-based spells and physical enhancement potions
classBonus.Ninja: Bonus to thrown-projectile spells and stealth magic
classBonus.Priest: Bonus to OH-based healing, VI potions, and ZO utility
classBonus.Wizard: Bonus to FUL fire, DES darkness, and complex multi-rune spells

originalAtari.provenance: Canonical extracted Atari reference payloads. These fields preserve source-truth descriptors and formulas, not necessarily the remake runtime interpretation layer.
